title: Unattended server
summary: A persistent install serves the LAN unattended: SSH by keys only, binary-safe transfers, supervised services with logs, synchronized time, clean reboots, watchdog recovery, the resting state and remote upgrades with automatic rollback.

categories.title: Keys-only SSH: per-install host keys, per-account authorized keys, no password or telnet
Binary-safe exec stdin and verified uploads over SSH
Service supervision: dependencies, restart with backoff, crash-loop reporting, graceful stop
Per-service and kernel logs with boot IDs and size-bounded rotation
SNTP synchronization, slewing after the first step, RTC kept in UTC
Reboot and power-off after sync and a read-only remount; a panic reboots
A hang is reset by the watchdog back into the persistent install
Test boots preempt the persistent install and the machine returns to it
Remote upgrades verified over SSH and rolled back automatically
